# factfile.md

> factfile.md is an open standard for one Markdown file at a website's root that gives AI agents a business's key facts (what it offers, who it is for and not for, prices and how to start), each linked to the page that shows it.

The specification is a draft for public comment (v0.1). Free command-line tools draft a file from a website, check it, and make the human-readable page.

## Key pages

- [factfile.md](https://factfile.dev/factfile.md): key facts about this project: what it offers, who it is for, prices and how to start
- [Specification](https://factfile.dev/spec.md): the full factfile.md specification in Markdown
- [What is factfile.md?](https://factfile.dev/what-is-factfile): a short explanation and how it relates to llms.txt and schema.org
- [Tools](https://factfile.dev/tools): generate, setup, page and validate commands

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/factfile-dev/factfile): specification, examples and tools on GitHub
- [Examples](https://github.com/factfile-dev/factfile/tree/main/examples): complete files for a software product, a local business and an online shop
